notes.title: Modern Game Tycoon Update 3.0.0
notes.content:
Changelog:
Full rework of main game mechanics:

    Worker skill system,
    Game features system,
    Game development system,
    Game sell system,
    Marketing system,

New game engines,
New game genres,
Rebalance of engines, platforms, themes, genres,
Added publishers,
Added game updates,
Added sprites for created games,
All game ui reworked,
Added shadows and some other shader changes, 
Save/Load system fixed,
Achievement system fixed,
Other small changes.

notes.title: Modern Game Tycoon Update 2.0.1
notes.content:
List of changes:
Fixed a bug where during development, after exiting to the main menu, the development sound continued.
Fixed a bug where, after loading a save, tables for which workers were assigned were marked as not assigned.
Fixed a bug due to which the window with the ability to take a loan did not appear.

notes.title: Modern Game Tycoon Update 2.0.0
notes.content:
List of changes:
Almost all game code has been rewritten
Temporarily removed the ability to save multiple files
Significantly reduced the number of bugs
Complete rebalance of everything
Added new worker classes
Worker skill system reworked
Slightly redesigned project creation system

notes.title: Modern Game Tycoon Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with the inability to find and load saves.
Now if you loaded a save, then the character animations should be loaded.
Small changes in ui.

notes.title: Modern Game Tycoon Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
Fixed a bug due to which, after the cancellation of the contract, games could not be developed.
Fixed a bug due to which, after loading a save, the characters were turned in the wrong direction.
Fixed a bug when to show personnel it was necessary to click on its type twice.

notes.title: Modern Game Tycoon Update 1.1.1
notes.content: Fixed bug with incorrect marketing bonus.

notes.title: Modern Game Tycoon Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
List of changes:
Added a system for updating computers over time.
Added indicators of the complexity of the project.
Added tooltips.
Added 9 new character models.
List of fixes:
Fixed a bug when the language was French instead of German.
Fixed several bugs with localizations.
Corrected the sizes of several texts.
Fixed several bugs with saving and loading.

notes.title: Fixed some bugs
notes.content:
Fixed several bugs related to localization, statistics and loading of savegames. 
Added restrictions on game creation at the start of the campaign.
